status: PROVISIONAL — the axes are settled (SPEC §5); the ADJACENCY GRAPH below is a guess awaiting Tier-3 calibration. See SPEC §13.

policy.four_axes: A population is a 5-tuple as of 2026-08-08 (health_status added). All variants are precomputed offline, so the delta between them costs table rows, not runtime queries.
policy.unknown_is_a_value: Every axis has an 'unknown' member. Unknown is a known unknown that the adjacency graph handles explicitly — never silently treated as the general case (invariant 5).
policy.composition: Overall pop_match across the four axes = WORST axis. All four exact -> 'exact'. Any axis 'different' -> 'different'. Otherwise 'adjacent'. Conservative by construction; this composition rule is itself provisional.
policy.deficiency_is_the_sign_flipper: Deficiency status is the axis that flips signs hardest and the one the user genuinely does not know. v1 shows both numbers rather than picking one.

sex.note: female <-> male is 'different', not 'adjacent'. Single-sex trials transfer poorly and the literature is male-skewed in sports outcomes.

definitions.deficient: below the clinical deficiency threshold at baseline
definitions.insufficient: sub-optimal but above the deficiency threshold
definitions.unknown: baseline status not measured or not reported

deficiency_status.note: deficient <-> replete is 'different'. Repletion of a deficiency and supplementation of a replete person are different interventions, and this is where the sign flips.

definitions.not_pregnant: explicitly not pregnant, or a population where it does not apply

pregnancy.note: pregnant/lactating <-> not_pregnant is 'different' in both directions. Safety and physiology both diverge.

definitions.healthy: participants recruited as healthy / general population, or for a non-clinical trait (athletes, students, poor sleepers)
definitions.disease: participants recruited FOR a diagnosed condition — the trial is testing the ingredient as a therapy
definitions.mixed: both, or a condition so mild it is a risk factor rather than a diagnosis

health_status.note: healthy <-> disease is 'different'. MEASURED 2026-08-08: 15 of 80 studies (19%) in the creatine corpus were disease trials — Huntington's, Parkinson's, HIV, cancer cachexia, haemodialysis, muscular dystrophy. On the original four axes each scored pop_match='exact' against a general-adult product, because age/sex/deficiency/pregnancy cannot express 'this trial was in patients'. Their nulls counted at FULL weight as evidence that creatine does not build muscle in healthy adults.
